train_scratchgan: train a ScratchGAN model with LSTM generator and discriminator on a text dataset
evaluate_pair_scratchgan: evaluate a trained ScratchGAN generator-discriminator pair and compute FID metrics
run_experiment_main: run the ScratchGAN experiment in train or evaluate_pair mode via absl flags
build_lstm_generator: build an LSTM generator with configurable layers, embeddings, and dropout for text generation
build_lstm_discriminator: build an LSTM discriminator network with layer norm and dropout for sequence classification
